name: Akō (Japan)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and green divided by wavy lines, the white charged with the Akō city emblem: a red eight-pointed star-like device with a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Akō, a city in Hyōgo Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted in November 1971; the emblem dates from 1 September 1951.

features.role: Akō city emblem — an eight-pointed star-like device with a stylised character
